# brig sandbox connect

Open a terminal in a sandbox

## Synopsis

```text
brig sandbox connect [VM] SANDBOX
```

## Description

Attach this terminal to a sandbox's main process, as openshell sandbox
connect does. Ctrl-P Ctrl-Q, or Ctrl-D, detaches and leaves it running.

## Examples

```sh
brig sandbox connect dev webapp
brig use dev && brig sandbox connect webapp
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-w, --workspace string` | the workspace of the gateway to work in (default: $BRIG\_WORKSPACE, else default) |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
